description: Cases with 'known_miss' are documented limitations, excluded from the pass requirement. Knowledge retrieval benchmark: natural spoken questions over knowledge_base/personal_data.json. 'expect' lists the record types the top result may be (any of them); null means retrieval must return nothing, so the assistant says the answer isn't in the records instead of guessing.
